verdict.rationale: Databricks documents account/workspace-level budgets that track and alert on spending across teams, projects, or workspaces (docs-58/61/83), which covers cost monitoring. However, the evidence pack does not document automatic actions that stop a runaway query or auto-suspend idle compute (e.g., cluster auto-termination policies, query timeouts, or resource monitors that kill jobs) — only budget tracking/alerting is shown, and query-monitoring evidence (docs-26) is about query performance/notifications, not cost enforcement. missing for 10: explicit auto-suspend/auto-termination of idle clusters, automatic runaway-query kill mechanisms, and independent confirmation that budgets can trigger enforcement rather than just alerts.
